title: Identify Operator Station Components (Tipper, Chute, Stacklights, HMI, Push-Buttons, Rotary Station)
summary: Walk up to the OptiSweep operator station and visually locate the key components used to receive parcels from the tippers: two tippers, chute, two stacklights, operator station HMI, four push-buttons, and rotary station.
when_to_use: Use when you need to visually confirm where the operator-station components are located so you can interact with the operator station HMI and push-buttons and understand how parcels flow from the tippers to the chute and rotary station.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to troubleshoot tipper faults, HMI alarms, or system faults—this procedure only identifies physical components and their locations.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the on-site visual identification of the operator-station components.
safety_notes: Rotary station pinch point: Be careful not to pinch fingers between the chute and the station when rotating the bag racks.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the operator station on the live system
Operator station visual reference (Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1 from the manual)

access_required: Physical access to the operator station on the live system
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual v3, section 3.2 (Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1)

visual_references.description: Labeled photograph of the operator station (panels removed for clarity) showing Item 1 Tipper, Item 2 Chute, Item 3 Stacklight, Item 5 Operator station HMI, Item 6 Push-buttons, Item 7 Rotary station (Table 3-1).
Rotary station photo showing bag racks and foot brake; includes caution about pinch point between chute and station when rotating bag racks.
Operator station push-button panel photo showing TIP LEFT, SURE POST LEFT, SURE POST RIGHT, TIP RIGHT, and emergency stop (Item 5 in Figure 3-3).

Operator station HMI manual control screen (VISU_MANCONTROL) showing the informational banner and manual controls (e.g., GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE, LAMP TEST, LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET, LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE).

steps.title: Locate the operator station area where parcels are received from the tippers
steps.purpose: Establish the correct physical area before identifying individual components.
steps.instruction: Walk to the OptiSweep operator station area where an operator receives parcels from the tippers.
steps.expected_result: You are at the operator station area that contains (at minimum) the two tippers, chute, rotary station, operator station HMI screen, and push-buttons.
steps.healthy_condition: The operator station area is visible and includes the operator station components described in Table 3-1 (Tipper, Chute, Stacklight, Operator station HMI, Push-buttons, Rotary station).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the operator station area that receives parcels from the tippers (components are not present in the expected area).

actions.label: Visual scan for operator station components
actions.exact_action: Walk up to the operator station area where an operator receives parcels from the tippers.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station area cannot be located, stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The operator station is the area where an operator receives parcels from the tippers.”

steps.title: Identify the two tippers at the operator station
steps.purpose: Confirm the two tipper units that deliver parcels to the chute.
steps.instruction: At the operator station, visually locate the two tippers (Tipper = Item 1 in Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1).
steps.expected_result: Both tippers are visible at the operator station and correspond to Item 1 (Tipper) in Figure 3-1.
steps.healthy_condition: Two tipper assemblies are present in the operator station area.
steps.failure_condition: One or both tippers cannot be located.

actions.label: Locate Tipper (Item 1)
actions.exact_action: Identify the two tippers at the operator station.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1 lists Item 1 as “Tipper” and shows two tippers in the operator station.

steps.title: Identify the chute positioned to receive parcels from the tippers
steps.purpose: Confirm the receiving path from tippers to the operator station.
steps.instruction: Visually locate the chute (Chute = Item 2 in Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1) positioned to receive parcels from the tippers.
steps.expected_result: The chute is visible and corresponds to Item 2 (Chute) in Figure 3-1.
steps.healthy_condition: A chute is present in the operator station area aligned with the tippers’ parcel delivery.

actions.label: Locate Chute (Item 2)
actions.exact_action: Identify the chute positioned to receive parcels from the tippers.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

steps.title: Identify the two stacklights mounted on the top of the frame on either side of the chute
steps.purpose: Confirm the visual status indicators associated with the operator station.
steps.instruction: Look on the top of the frame on either side of the chute and identify the two stacklights (Stacklight = Item 3 in Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1).
steps.expected_result: Two stacklights are visible on the top of the frame, one on each side of the chute, matching Item 3 (Stacklight).
steps.healthy_condition: Two stacklights are mounted on top of the frame on either side of the chute.
steps.failure_condition: One or both stacklights cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame).

actions.label: Locate Stacklights (Item 3)
actions.exact_action: Identify the two stacklights mounted on the top of the frame on either side of the chute.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Two stacklights are mounted on the top of the frame on either side of the chute.” and Table 3-1 lists Item 3 as “Stacklight.”

steps.title: Identify the operator station HMI screen
steps.purpose: Confirm where the operator station HMI is located for interaction.
steps.instruction: Find the operator station HMI screen (Operator station HMI = Item 5 in Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1).
steps.expected_result: The operator station HMI screen is visible and corresponds to Item 5 (Operator station HMI) in Figure 3-1.
steps.healthy_condition: An HMI screen is present at the operator station and matches the expected location in Figure 3-1.
steps.failure_condition: The operator station HMI screen cannot be located.

actions.label: Locate Operator station HMI (Item 5)
actions.exact_action: Identify the operator station HMI screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1 lists Item 5 as “Operator station HMI.”

steps.title: Identify the four push-buttons on the operator station
steps.purpose: Confirm the physical controls used to interact with the operator station.
steps.instruction: Locate the push-button panel on the operator station (Push-buttons = Item 6 in Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1). On the push-button panel, identify the TIP LEFT, TIP RIGHT, and the Surepost left/right buttons as shown in the push-button photo.
steps.expected_result: The push-button panel is visible and corresponds to Item 6 (Push-buttons) in Figure 3-1; the panel includes TIP LEFT, TIP RIGHT, SURE POST LEFT, and SURE POST RIGHT buttons.
steps.healthy_condition: The push-button panel is present and the labeled buttons are visible.
steps.failure_condition: The push-button panel cannot be located or the expected labeled buttons are not present.

actions.label: Locate Push-buttons (Item 6)
actions.exact_action: Identify the four push-buttons on the operator station.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 3-3 shows the operator station push-button panel including TIP LEFT, SURE POST LEFT, SURE POST RIGHT, TIP RIGHT, and an emergency stop push-button.

steps.title: Identify the rotary station
steps.purpose: Confirm the bag rack area under the chute used for parcel bags.
steps.instruction: Locate the rotary station under the chute (Rotary station = Item 7 in Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1).
steps.expected_result: The rotary station is visible under the chute and corresponds to Item 7 (Rotary station) in Figure 3-1.
steps.healthy_condition: A rotary station is present under the chute with bag racks; it is the station where bags are manually replenished by operators.
steps.failure_condition: The rotary station cannot be located under the chute.
stop_or_escalate_if: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 3-1 / Table 3-1 lists Item 7 as “Rotary station.”
“The rotary station, located under the chute, has bag racks for parcel bags.”

success_criteria: All seven operator-station features from Table 3-1 are found in the expected locations: two tippers, chute, two stacklights on top of the frame on either side of the chute, operator station HMI, four push-buttons, and rotary station.
healthy_conditions: Two tippers are present at the operator station.
A chute is present to receive parcels from the tippers.
Two stacklights are mounted on the top of the frame on either side of the chute.
An operator station HMI screen is present.
A push-button panel is present with TIP LEFT, TIP RIGHT, SURE POST LEFT, and SURE POST RIGHT buttons.
A rotary station is present under the chute with bag racks.
failure_conditions: Any of the required components (tippers, chute, stacklights, operator station HMI, push-buttons, rotary station) cannot be located.
escalation_guidance: If any component cannot be located (e.g., stacklights not visible on top of the frame or HMI/push-buttons not present), stop and escalate to FORTNA support for site-specific verification.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Operator station includes two tippers, chute, plastic curtains, rotary station, HMI screen, and four push-buttons; two stacklights mounted on top of the frame on either side of the chute. Figure 3-1 and Table 3-1 list items 1–7.
Figure 3-3 shows the operator station push-button panel including TIP LEFT, SURE POST LEFT, SURE POST RIGHT, TIP RIGHT, and an emergency stop push-button.
Rotary station is located under the chute; includes caution about pinch point between chute and station when rotating bag racks.

missing_details: This procedure is component identification only. It does not include HMI navigation or fault interpretation because the provided section text only defines component locations.
